sources.facts: Three total floors, one contract per added floor; no previous-floor size prerequisite. One default preset per character, four maximum. Save and load layouts, select unlocked room size, grid/free placement. Furniture effects become account-wide. These edit capabilities match current native HousingData options; NA details are not silently treated as fresh CN body.

For housing achievements, the online character with the most furniture is evaluated. Targets are placed50/100/200; current native definitions retain these targets. This contradicts summing different characters or counting repeated saves.
